description: What crypto Twitter is saying over the last 24h: one-line takeaway, top stories, narratives heating or cooling, hard numbers with their source URL, and notable posts from credible accounts. Without a topic it returns the latest scheduled market snapshot and never makes a live read: stale (meta.status) once the snapshot is older than 6 hours, unseeded when none exists. With a topic it makes a live read. BCA analysis plus X post links, never reposted post text. Pro tier.

topic.description: Optional focus: a token, sector or theme (e.g. 'solana', 'restaking'). Omit for the whole market.

name: get_ct_pulse
